Name: Argus
Author: ofnature
Punchline: Submarine and airship tracker with EXP planning and one-click route entry.
Description: Tracks every Free Company submarine and airship this client has seen, shows out/returned counts on the server info bar, calculates voyage EXP and rank-ups, suggests routes around the vessel's rank, range, fuel and unlocked sectors (with must-include sectors and progression unlocks), and fills the in-game voyage planner with one click. Loot history, supply warnings and a part optimizer. Companion to Daedalus.
